articles.title: Thailand and Cambodia sign truce to halt fierce border conflict
articles.summary: Thailand and Cambodia have agreed to halt weeks of intense border clashes, marking the worst fighting between the Southeast Asian nations in years. The agreement, reached on Saturday, aims to de-escalate tensions that have seen significant military engagement. This diplomatic breakthrough is crucial for regional stability and resolving long-standing territorial disputes between the two neighbours.
